title: What a Godly Man Does When Prayer Feels Empty (It's Not Quitting)
caption:
Prayer feels empty. A godly man keeps praying.

No warmth, no words, nothing coming back. It's easy to read that silence as God leaving. Scripture says otherwise. David asked "How long, O Lord?" and the psalm stayed in the Bible. Romans 8:26 says the Spirit prays for us when we have nothing left to say.

So keep the appointment, pray the honest sentence, and ask one brother to pray for you this week.

Save this for the next dry stretch.
